changelog:
Initial release of the deterministic SanMar API toolkit.

- Wraps SanMar's SOAP web services and PromoStandards order-shipment service with typed CLI tools.
- Supports product search, inventory and pricing checks, cart validation, purchase order submission/tracking, PO PDF parsing, and color code resolution.
- Purely deterministic JSON-in/JSON-out interface, no external dependencies except Python 3.11+ and requests.
- Supports optional features (PDF parse, SFTP color resolution) with pypdf/paramiko.
- All actions accessible via a single CLI entrypoint.
- Credentials are provided via environment variables or inline JSON; FTP credentials are handled separately.
- Only purchase order creation is write-capable and requires explicit confirmation; all other actions are safe reads.
